messages:
Sam: Quick thread from today's all-hands Q&A  folks wanted a bit more color on timelines and launch cohorts for API, Console, and Optimize. I'll capture notes and owners here.
Jia: Short version: API streaming + rate-limit SLA -> internal beta 5w, public beta 9w, GA 15w. Console dashboards v2 -> pilot (invite-only) 6w, public beta 11w. Optimize recommendations -> internal alpha 3w, public beta 9w.
Raj: For pilots, how many customers are we thinking? ops needs to reserve capacity.
Jia: Pilot cohort ~10 customers, primarily low-risk accounts. We'll tag them in the Console with a feature flag. Ops: reserve a single Dedicated pool for pilot traffic.
Noor: SDK compatibility question  will old clients break when streaming SLA is enforced?
Jia: No breaking changes. Streaming behavior will be opt-in initially. SDK v2.1 will add explicit streaming helpers; we'll keep legacy endpoints for a grace period (6 months).
Leah: can PMs get a one-page milestone map for communication? needed for customer success and sales.
Sam: Leah will own the milestone map and public-facing blurb. Leah: can you compile by EOD Friday?
Leah: yes, I'll draft and share with product@redwood for edits.
Raj: telemetry dependency note: Optimize needs per-request latency & token-count exports from Dedicated. Is that on the infra roadmap?
Jia: yes, infra enqueued telemetry export in Dedicated 2.2 next sprint (ETA 3w). If infra slips, public beta for Optimize will be postponed by the same amount.
Noor: security/privacy checkpoint for Optimize? customers asked about PII in telemetry.
Sam: security clearance required before public beta. Security and Privacy will sign off during the 2-week pre-beta window. Owner: Noor.
Jia: deploy-bot: pushing a staging build of console-dashboards to staging now.
deploy-bot: Deployed branch: feature/console-dash-v2 -> staging @ 1802456820 :rocket:
Leah: rollback plan question from the ops guild: how fast can we flip the pilot flag if we see regressions?
Jia: pilot flag flips in <2min. For GA we have a traffic-splitting toggle and a circuit-breaker that drains to previous version. DB migrations will be reversible and behind a flag for the first 14 days.
Raj: can we get a small matrix for model+quantization guidance for Optimize? ops wants concrete defaults.
Jia: Optimize will ship an initial recommendations matrix (community models + Redwood profiles). Owner: Raj will help produce it. ETA aligned with public beta (9w).
Noor: action items recap?
Leah: Recap: Jia -> publish timeline doc + public beta dates; Leah -> milestone map + comms; Raj -> quant-recommendation matrix + ops capacity plan; Noor -> security/privacy sign-off plan; Sam -> exec rollback sign-off.
Sam: thanks everyone. I'll post a short pinned doc in #product-updates once Jia's timeline is live. If you want into the pilot cohort, email product@redwood. :raised_hands:
Jia: I'll also add a note listing exact SDK version pins for the JS/Python releases in that doc.
Leah: will circulate the draft to PM guild and CS. Closing loop here unless folks have blockers.
